meta.title: Panel transparency utils
meta.description: Adds a full-window wallpaper and controls how the DSH panels sit over it. Configure the transparency-utils row in the profile's cordis.patch.yml: set image to an absolute local image path (served by the plugin, so no file:// URL is needed), or background to a CSS color, gradient, or remote url(...), plus opacity. panelOpacity and panelBlur tune the translucent and frosted panels: text boxes, code boxes, cards, menus, hover previews, and the Trajectory view. backgroundBlur blurs the wallpaper, and composerFadeHeight adds a wallpaper veil above the composer that fades transcript text out and hides it behind the input. Reload the page after changing the configuration. The defaults leave the window unchanged.
